## Change summary

Describe the user-visible or internal behavior changed and link the relevant
existing product or architecture decision.

## Evidence for this candidate

- Candidate revision:
- Local pre-push commands and observed results:
- Database checks: `Not applicable`, `Not run`, `Passed`, or `Failed`; include
  the reason when not run:
- Hosted CI: `Not requested`, `Queued`, `Passed`, `Failed`, or `Not run`; include
  a run reference when available:
- Remaining gaps or follow-up:

Use the exact states and criteria in `QA.md`. Hosted CI is manually started;
record its actual state for this candidate revision. A local pass is not a
hosted result. Mark a check passed only after observing a successful execution.

## Review and acceptance

- [ ] Applicable quality evidence is recorded, including skipped and
  unavailable checks.
- [ ] Relevant accepted ADRs and product boundaries were preserved or the
  conflict is identified for resolution.
- [ ] Human review and acceptance are recorded through the existing pull
  request process.
